Compare · Beta

Compare

Compare two texts, files, PDFs or pictures and see every change. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Compare has these main features: Texts and code side by side or unified, word by word; JSON by key and CSV by row and cell. It opens Text, JSON, PDF, Any image.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Compare

  • Compare two texts and see what changed
  • Compare two PDF files
  • Compare two images and find the differences
  • Compare two JSON or CSV files
